items.label: Urban Road Speed Limit (Unmarked)
items.value: 50 km/h

items.label: Slow Lane & Narrow Road Speed Limit
items.value: 40 km/h

items.label: Railroad Level Crossing Approach Speed
items.value: 15 km/h

items.label: Speed vs. Braking Distance Physics
items.value: Doubling speed quadruples (4x) required braking distance

items.label: Pedestrian Crosswalk Stopping Distance
items.value: Stop at least 3 meters (4 zebra stripes width) before crosswalk

items.label: Turn Signal Advance Distance
items.value: Activate turn signals at least 30 meters prior to turning/lane change

items.label: Prohibited Stopping Zone Distance
items.value: Prohibited within 10 meters of intersections, bus stops, or hydrants

items.label: Cargo Rear Extension Limit
items.value: Max 50 cm beyond rear wheel axle

items.label: Cargo Width Extension Limit
items.value: Max 10 cm beyond handlebar outer edges

items.label: Small Light Motorcycle Weight Limit
items.value: Max 30 kg

items.label: Regular Light Motorcycle Weight Limit
items.value: Max 60 kg

items.label: Heavy Motorcycle Weight Limit
items.value: Max 90 kg

items.label: Minimum Tire Tread Depth (Motorcycle)
items.value: 1.0 mm (worn to indicator fails inspection)

items.label: Helmet Standards
items.value: Must wear BSMI approved helmet with fastened chinstrap

items.label: Administrative Fine BAC Limit
items.value: 0.15 mg/L breath alcohol or 0.03% BAC

items.label: Criminal Offense Prosecution BAC Limit
items.value: 0.25 mg/L breath alcohol or 0.05% BAC

items.label: Motorcycle Drunk Driving Fine
items.value: NT$15,000 to NT$90,000 + License suspension

items.label: Refusing Sobriety Breathalyzer Test Fine
items.value: NT$180,000 + License revocation + Impoundment

items.label: Repeat Drunk Driving Window (10 Years)
items.value: Max fine + License revocation + Public photo disclosure

items.label: Passengers Riding with Drunk Driver Fine
items.value: NT$6,000 to NT$15,000 joint fine

items.label: Running Red Light Penalty (Motorcycle)
items.value: NT$1,800 to NT$5,400 fine + 3 demerit points

items.label: Handheld Mobile Phone Fine (Motorcycle)
items.value: NT$1,000 fine for operating handheld phone while riding

items.label: Demerit Points License Suspension Cap
items.value: Accumulating 12 demerit points in 1 year = 2 months suspension

items.label: First Aid Priority Order
items.value: 1. Airway (B) → 2. Bleeding (A) → 3. Fracture (C)

items.label: CPR Compression to Ventilation Ratio
items.value: 30 Chest Compressions : 2 Rescue Breaths (30:2)

items.label: CPR Chest Compression Rate & Depth
items.value: 100 to 120 compressions per minute; 5 to 6 cm depth

items.label: Suspected Spinal Trauma Airway Method
items.value: Jaw-Thrust maneuver (do NOT tilt head)

items.label: Railroad Breakdown SOS 3-Step Action
items.value: 1. Press Red Emergency Button → 2. Push vehicle clear → 3. Run clear

items.label: Straight vs. Turning Priority
items.value: Straight-going motorcycle has absolute priority over turning vehicle

items.label: Left Turn vs. Right Turn Priority
items.value: Left-turning vehicle MUST yield to right-turning vehicle

items.label: Equal Width Unsignalized Intersection
items.value: Yield to vehicle approaching from your RIGHT side

items.label: Solid Red Line Road Marking
items.value: No temporary stopping or parking 24 hours a day

items.label: Solid Yellow Line Road Marking
items.value: No parking 7 AM to 8 PM (temporary stopping <3 min allowed)

items.label: Double Solid Yellow Line
items.value: No crossing, straddling, or U-turns under any circumstances
